final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.order_type_mix, s1.record_count, CAST(s1.record_count AS REAL) / s2.total_count AS share FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM step3) SELECT s3.order_type_mix, s3.record_count, s3.share, s3.share - s4.avg_share AS difference FROM step3 AS s3 JOIN step4 AS s4 ON s4.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.share > s4.avg_share
